title: Every n-dimensional subspace is a rotated horizontal plane
statement: For all natural numbers n and l and every linear subspace T of R^{n+l} = Amb n l with dim T = n, there is a linear isometry equivalence q of R^{n+l} such that rotatedPlane q = q(horizontalPlane n l) = T, where horizontalPlane n l is the span of the first n standard basis vectors e_{castAdd l i}, i < n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → ∃ q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ, rotatedPlane q = T
